messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: spin() tutorial
parts:
As a summary of my own learning, I've posted here directions
for using spin() to edit existing R scripts into more readable web pages:
http://rpubs.com/alobo/spintutorial

It is amazing how just few simple codes transform the script into a web page.
The cost-benefit is extraordinary.

Many thanks for the help found in this group (in particular from Yihui Xie)
and for pointing errors. Please note the list of issues that I've
not been able to solve at the end.

Agus

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] spin() tutorial
parts:
Thanks for sharing. It looks great. For the last issue mentioned in
your tutorial, you can use something like this to skip the evaluation:

#+ eval=FALSE
library(knitr)
spin ('miknitr-spin.R');


Regards,
Yihui
